description_en: Queries the split bill summary for a specified billing month or date, allowing you to view the costs of resources and split items and filter the results by product, account, business unit, resource group, and tag
description_zh: 查询用户指定账单月份或指定账单日期的分账汇总，支持查看资源及分拆项的费用，并按产品、账号、财务单元、资源组、标签等条件筛选
name: ListSplitSummary

fields.help_en: The tag key. It cannot be empty or contain only whitespace characters
fields.help_zh: 标签键，不能为空或全空白字符串
fields.name: tag_key

fields.help_en: The list of tag values. Matches any given value under the specified tag key. If this parameter is not passed or an empty array is passed, only the existence of the tag key is required
fields.help_zh: 标签值列表，匹配指定标签键下任一给定值。不传或传空数组时，仅要求存在该标签键
fields.name: tag_values

parameters.help_en: The resource tag filter conditions. Different objects in the list and multiple values of the same tag key are matched by using the OR operator. The tag filters are combined with the cost category filters and CommonFilters by using the AND operator
parameters.help_zh: 资源标签筛选条件。列表内不同对象及同一标签键的多个值按“或”匹配；标签筛选整体与成本分组筛选及 CommonFilters 按“且”组合
parameters.name: tag_filters

fields.help_en: The name of the cost category. It cannot be empty or contain only whitespace characters
fields.help_zh: 成本分组名称，不能为空或全空白字符串
fields.name: cost_categories_key

fields.help_en: The list of cost category values. Matches any given value under the specified cost category. If this parameter is not passed or an empty array is passed, only the existence of the cost category is required
fields.help_zh: 成本分组值列表，匹配指定成本分组下任一给定值。不传或传空数组时，仅要求存在该成本分组
fields.name: cost_categories_values

parameters.help_en: The cost category filter conditions. Different objects in the list and multiple values of the same cost category are matched by using the OR operator. The cost category filters are combined with the tag filters and CommonFilters by using the AND operator
parameters.help_zh: 成本分组筛选条件。列表内不同对象及同一成本分组的多个值按“或”匹配；成本分组筛选整体与标签筛选及 CommonFilters 按“且”组合
parameters.name: cost_categories_filters

fields.help_en: The name of the filter field. This parameter is required when setting conditions. For supported fields and match rules, see the supplementary description of request parameters
fields.help_zh: 筛选字段名，设置条件时必填；支持字段及匹配规则见请求参数补充说明
fields.name: filter_field

fields.help_en:
The match method. It is case-insensitive and defaults to IN if it is not passed or is empty. Valid values:
IN: Includes the specified values.
NOT: Excludes the specified values.
PREFIX: Matches the literal prefix.
For the supported scope of each field, see the supplementary description of request parameters
fields.help_zh: 匹配方式，忽略大小写，不传或为空时默认 IN。IN：包含；NOT：排除；PREFIX：字面前缀匹配。各字段支持范围见请求参数补充说明
fields.name: operation

fields.help_en: The filter values. This parameter is always a string array. Use an array even for a single value, a Boolean value, or an account ID
fields.help_zh: 筛选值，始终为字符串数组，单值、布尔值和账号 ID 也使用数组
fields.name: values

parameters.help_en: The common filter conditions. Supports filtering by product, commodity, region, billing item, fee type, resource, account, business unit, resource group, and split item. Different fields are combined by using the AND operator. Pass only one object for the same field. For more information, see the supplementary description of request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 通用筛选条件，支持产品、商品、地域、计费项、费用类型、资源、账号、财务单元、资源组及分拆项等。不同字段按“且”组合；同一字段仅传一个对象。详见请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: common_filters

fields.help_en: The end time. This parameter is inclusive. Required for DAILY in the yyyy-MM-dd format. It must not be earlier than StartTime and must be in the same month as StartTime. Optional for MONTHLY. If passed, it must be the same as StartTime
fields.help_zh: 结束时间，包含该时间。`DAILY` 时必填，格式为 `yyyy-MM-dd`，不得早于 `StartTime`，且须与 `StartTime` 在同一月份；`MONTHLY` 时可不传，传入时须与 `StartTime` 相同
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The time granularity. This parameter is required. It is case-insensitive. Valid values:
DAILY: Aggregates data by day.
MONTHLY: Aggregates data by month
fields.help_zh: 时间粒度，业务必填。DAILY：按天汇总；MONTHLY：按月汇总。忽略大小写
fields.name: granularity

fields.help_en: The start time. This parameter is required and is inclusive. The format is yyyy-MM for MONTHLY and yyyy-MM-dd for DAILY
fields.help_zh: 开始时间，业务必填，包含该时间。MONTHLY 时格式为 yyyy-MM；DAILY 时格式为 yyyy-MM-dd
fields.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The query time range. This parameter is required and includes Granularity, StartTime, and EndTime. You can query only one billing month per request. If passed, it overrides the legacy flat time parameters
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间范围，业务必填，包含 Granularity、StartTime 和 EndTime；一次请求仅查询一个账单月份。传入后覆盖旧版平铺时间参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page query. Do not pass this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken returned in the previous response as is. The query ends when the token is empty or no longer returned. Do not construct or parse the token yourself. Keep Period, account scope, all filter conditions, and MaxResults consistent during pagination
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询令牌。首次查询不传，后续原样传入上一次响应的 `NextToken`；为空或不再返回时结束。令牌不得自行构造或解析。分页时保持 `Period`、账号范围、全部筛选条件和 `MaxResults` 一致
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return per page. Used in combination with NextToken. Pass a positive integer. We recommend that you explicitly set this parameter and keep it unchanged during pagination. The actual number of returned records may be less than this value
parameters.help_zh: 每页期望返回的最大记录数，与 `NextToken` 配合使用。请传入正整数，建议显式设置；分页时保持不变。实际返回条数可能少于该值
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The list of account IDs to access. If empty, all accounts under the current enterprise entity are selected. The actual scope is limited by permissions
fields.help_zh: 需要访问的账号ID列表；为空时表示选择当前企业实体下全部账号，实际范围受权限限制
fields.name: account_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the enterprise entity
fields.name: ec_id

parameters.help_en: The query scope for enterprises and accounts. If not passed, the bill scope of the current account is queried. Specify only one enterprise object per request. The actual accessible scope is limited by permissions
parameters.help_zh: 企业与账号查询范围。不传时查询当前账号自身的账单范围。一次请求仅指定一个企业对象，实际可访问范围受权限限制
parameters.name: ec_id_account_ids

schema.description_en: The response object for querying split bill summaries. It includes the request ID, pagination information, and split bill summary records. Private fields are for internal use only and their return depends on the query mode and data
schema.description_zh: 查询账单分账汇总的响应对象，包含请求标识、分页信息和分账汇总记录。私有字段仅供内部链路使用，是否返回取决于查询模式和数据

Data.description_en: The array of split bill summary records returned in this request. It may be empty if no matching records are found
Data.description_zh: 本次返回的分账汇总记录数组，无匹配记录时可能为空

items.description_en: A split bill summary record that describes the billing cycle, product resources, split items, cost attribution, and amounts. Unless otherwise specified, fields in the record are returned as strings. Fields may be empty or not returned
items.description_zh: 一条分账汇总记录，描述账期、产品资源、分拆项、费用归属和金额。除特别说明外，记录内字段均以字符串返回；字段可能为空或不返回

AmountAfterCouponDeduction.description_en: The amount after coupon deduction, which equals AmountAfterPromotionDeduction minus CouponAmount
AmountAfterCouponDeduction.description_zh: 优惠券抵扣后金额，等于 AmountAfterPromotionDeduction - CouponAmount

AmountAfterPromotionDeduction.description_en: The amount after discount, which is the amount after applying discounts such as official website discounts and contract discounts, but before deducting coupon deductions. When the savings plan deduction data is complete, it equals ListPrice minus SavingPlanDeductListPrice minus PromotionAmount. When there is no savings plan deduction list price, it is calculated as ListPrice minus PromotionAmount
AmountAfterPromotionDeduction.description_zh: 优惠后金额，即应用官网优惠、合同折扣等优惠之后、尚未扣除优惠券抵扣的金额。订阅抵扣数据完整时等于 ListPrice - SavingPlanDeductListPrice - PromotionAmount；无订阅抵扣目录金额时按 ListPrice - PromotionAmount 处理

AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction.description_en: The amount after savings plan deduction, which equals ListPrice minus SavingPlanDeductListPrice. It may be empty when there is no savings plan deduction data
AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction.description_zh: 订阅抵扣后金额，等于 ListPrice - SavingPlanDeductListPrice；无订阅抵扣相关数据时可能为空
AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction.title_en: Amount after saving plan deduction (afterDiscountAmount - savingPlanDeductAmount)
AmountAfterSavingPlanDeduction.title_zh: Amount after saving plan deduction (afterDiscountAmount - savingPlanDeductAmount)

BillingDate.description_en: The billing date, which is the date when the user consumed the cloud service, in the format of yyyy-MM-dd. It has a value only when summarized by day
BillingDate.description_zh: 账单日期，即用户使用云产品的消费日期，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd。仅按天汇总时有值
BillingDate.title_en: Billing date (yyyy-MM-dd format, only for DAILY aggregation)
BillingDate.title_zh: Billing date (yyyy-MM-dd format, only for DAILY aggregation)

BillingItemCode.description_en: The billing item code, which is the billing item to which the cloud resource expense belongs. Whether it has a value depends on the split bill records and summary data
BillingItemCode.description_zh: 计费项 Code，云资源费用归属的计费项，是否有值取决于分账记录和汇总数据

BillingMonth.description_en: The billing month, which is the month to which the expense belongs, in the format of yyyy-MM
BillingMonth.description_zh: 账单月份，即费用所属的账单月，格式为 yyyy-MM

BillingQuantity.description_en: The usage, which is the total usage that is ultimately billed. It must be understood in combination with the product, billing item, and unit. Do not directly add up the values if the units or billing rules are different
BillingQuantity.description_zh: 用量，即最终参与计费的用量汇总。需结合产品、计费项和单位理解；单位或计费规则不同时不可直接相加

BillingQuantityUnit.description_en: The usage unit, used in conjunction with BillingQuantity
BillingQuantityUnit.description_zh: 用量单位，与 BillingQuantity 配合使用

ChargeDuration.description_en: The duration, which is the total duration of purchasing or using cloud products. It is used when the corresponding billing method includes duration
ChargeDuration.description_zh: 时长，即购买或使用云产品的时长汇总，在对应计费方式包含时长时使用

ChargeDurationUnit.description_en: The duration unit, used in conjunction with ChargeDuration
ChargeDurationUnit.description_zh: 时长单位，与 ChargeDuration 配合使用

ChargeType.description_en: The display name of the billing method, returned in the requested language, such as Subscription or Pay-as-you-go. Use Subscription or PayAsYouGo for filtering
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型的展示名称，随请求语言返回，例如预付费、后付费。筛选时请使用 `Subscription` 或 `PayAsYouGo`
ChargeType.title_en: 付费类型，按当前语言翻译；翻译键为 user.center.chargeType.v2.prepaid/postpaid。
ChargeType.title_zh: 付费类型，按当前语言翻译；翻译键为 user.center.chargeType.v2.prepaid/postpaid。

CommodityCode.description_en: The commodity code, which is the unique identifier of a specific commodity under a cloud service
CommodityCode.description_zh: 商品 Code，云产品下具体商品的唯一标识

ConsumeType.description_en: The display name of the transaction type, which identifies the transaction corresponding to the bill, such as new purchase, renewal, upgrade, downgrade, unsubscription, pay-as-you-go, and adjustment. Do not use the display name as the ConsumeType filter code
ConsumeType.description_zh: 交易类型的展示名称，标识账单对应的交易，例如新购、续订、升级、降级、退订、后付费、调账等。请勿将展示名称作为 ConsumeType 筛选编码

CostCategories.description_en: The cost categories, which indicate the cost category and category value that the record belongs to. Returned as a string. The specific content is subject to the bill record. It can be empty
CostCategories.description_zh: 成本分组，即记录所归属的成本分组及分组值，以字符串形式返回，具体内容以账单记录为准，可为空

CouponAmount.description_en: The coupon deduction amount. This amount cannot be used for invoicing
CouponAmount.description_zh: 优惠券抵扣金额，该部分金额不能用于开具发票

Currency.description_en: The currency corresponding to the amounts and prices
Currency.description_zh: 金额及价格对应的币种

FinanceUnitName.description_en: The finance unit name. A finance unit is a unit used to group or classify expenses and must be maintained by the user
FinanceUnitName.description_zh: 财务单元名称。财务单元是对费用进行分组或归类的单位，需要用户自行维护

HashKey.description_en: The identifier of the summary record, used as an opaque string. It can be empty. This identifier may change when summary dimensions such as resource groups and tags change
HashKey.description_zh: 汇总记录的标识，作为不透明字符串使用，可为空。资源组、标签等汇总维度变化时，该标识可能随之变化

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID at the billing granularity, which is the dimension for expense statistics and summary when a cloud service generates a bill. It may be different from the resource ID
InstanceId.description_zh: 实例ID（出账粒度），即云产品生成账单时费用统计和汇总的维度，可能与资源ID不同

InstanceName.description_en: The resource name, which is the custom name given by the user to the cloud resource. Whether it has a value depends on whether the product and resource information can be obtained
InstanceName.description_zh: 资源名称，即用户对云资源自定义的命名，是否有值取决于产品及资源信息是否可获取

InstanceSpec.description_en: The specification, which describes the specification of the resource or billing item associated with this record
InstanceSpec.description_zh: 规格，描述本条记录关联资源或计费项的规格

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address. It is returned only when the product supports it and the relevant resource information can be obtained
InternetIp.description_zh: 公网IP，仅在产品支持且能够获取相关资源信息时返回
InternetIp.title_en: 公网IP（接口查询回填，仅命中产品白名单有值）
InternetIp.title_zh: 公网IP（接口查询回填，仅命中产品白名单有值）

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address. It is returned only when the product supports it and the relevant resource information can be obtained
IntranetIp.description_zh: 私网IP，仅在产品支持且能够获取相关资源信息时返回
IntranetIp.title_en: 私网IP（接口查询回填，仅命中产品白名单有值）
IntranetIp.title_zh: 私网IP（接口查询回填，仅命中产品白名单有值）

LineItemType.description_en: The display name of the line item type, which identifies the nature of the expense generated by the bill, such as subscription prepaid expense, subscription unsubscription expense, pay-as-you-go expense, adjustment expense, and round-down expense. Do not use the display name as the LineItemType filter code
LineItemType.description_zh: 费用类型的展示名称，标识账单产生的费用性质，例如订阅预付费用、订阅退订费用、云资源按量费用、调账费用、抹零费用等。请勿将展示名称作为 LineItemType 筛选编码

ListPrice.description_en: The list price, which is the total list price of the selected configuration
ListPrice.description_zh: 目录总价，即所选配置的目录价总金额

ListPriceUnit.description_en: The price unit, used in conjunction with ListUnitPrice
ListPriceUnit.description_zh: 价格单位，与 ListUnitPrice 配合使用

ListUnitPrice.description_en: The list price, which is the list unit price of the commodity. Whether it has a value depends on the split bill and summary data. Do not multiply the total usage by a unit price to recalculate all bills
ListUnitPrice.description_zh: 官网目录价，即商品的列表单价，是否有值取决于分账及汇总数据。不能将汇总用量直接乘以某个单价来重算所有账单

ProductCode.description_en: The product code, which is the unique identifier of a specific cloud service on Alibaba Cloud
ProductCode.description_zh: 产品 Code，阿里云上某个具体云产品的唯一标识

PromotionAmount.description_en: The discount amount, which is the total discount amount on the bill, including official website discounts and contract discounts
PromotionAmount.description_zh: 优惠金额，即账单上总共优惠的金额，包含官网优惠、合同折扣等

PurchaseConfiguration.description_en: The billing item selection configuration, which describes the configurations related to the billing item
PurchaseConfiguration.description_zh: 计费项选型配置，描述与该计费项相关的配置内容

RegionCode.description_en: The region code, which is the logical region code where the cloud resource is located
RegionCode.description_zh: 地域 Code，云资源所在的逻辑地域编码

RegionName.description_en: The region name, which indicates the region selected when the order was placed
RegionName.description_zh: 地域名称，表示下单时选择的地域

RequireAmount.description_en: The payable amount (tax-inclusive), which is the actual amount the user needs to pay after applying various discounts, savings plan deductions, and coupons. When all amounts are complete, it equals ListPrice minus SavingPlanDeductListPrice minus PromotionAmount minus CouponAmount. Use this field for expense verification. If other amount fields are missing, do not treat null values as zero to calculate the payable amount
RequireAmount.description_zh: 应付金额（含税），即应用各种优惠、订阅抵扣及优惠券之后用户实际需要支付的金额。各项金额完整时等于 ListPrice - SavingPlanDeductListPrice - PromotionAmount - CouponAmount。费用核对以该字段为准；其他金额字段缺失时，请勿将空值按零处理并推算应付金额

ResourceGroup.description_en: The resource group, which is the group where cloud resources are placed as configured by the user in the Resource Management console
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 资源组，即用户在资源管理控制台设置的云资源所在分组

ResourceId.description_en: The resource ID, which is the identifier used to uniquely identify a resource in a cloud service
ResourceId.description_zh: 资源ID，云产品中用于唯一标识某个资源的标识符

ResourceOwnerAccountId.description_en: The resource ownership account ID, which is the ID of the account that actually uses the resource. It may be different from the purchasing account
ResourceOwnerAccountId.description_zh: 资源归属账号 ID，即实际使用资源的账号 ID，可能与购买账号不同

ResourcePurchaseAccountId.description_en: The resource purchaser account ID, which is the ID of the account that purchases the resource
ResourcePurchaseAccountId.description_zh: 资源购买账号 ID，即购买资源的账号 ID
ResourcePurchaseAccountId.title_en: Resource purchase account ID (user account ID)
ResourcePurchaseAccountId.title_zh: Resource purchase account ID (user account ID)

ResourceTag.description_en: The resource tags, which are custom tags added by the user to Alibaba Cloud resources. Returned as a string. It can be empty
ResourceTag.description_zh: 资源标签，即用户在阿里云资源上自定义的标签，以字符串形式返回，可为空

SavingPlanDeductAmount.description_en: The savings plan deduction amount, which is the committed amount consumed by the savings plan itself. It has a different meaning from SavingPlanDeductListPrice, cannot be used interchangeably, and should not be deducted from the payable amount again
SavingPlanDeductAmount.description_zh: 订阅抵扣金额，即订阅（节省计划）本身消耗的承付款金额。与 SavingPlanDeductListPrice 含义不同，不能相互替代，也不应再次从应付金额中扣减

SavingPlanDeductListPrice.description_en: The savings plan deduction list price, which is the total list price of the pay-as-you-go cloud resources deducted when a savings plan deduction is applied
SavingPlanDeductListPrice.description_zh: 订阅抵扣目录总价，即有订阅（节省计划）抵扣时，被抵扣的按量付费云资源目录总价
SavingPlanDeductListPrice.title_en: Saving plan deduct list price (SPN deduct original amount)
SavingPlanDeductListPrice.title_zh: Saving plan deduct list price (SPN deduct original amount)

ServiceEntity.description_en: The service entity, which is the name of the company that provides the product or service. Alibaba Cloud sells many products, and some products may be provided by different companies
ServiceEntity.description_zh: 服务主体，即提供产品或服务的公司名称。阿里云售卖的产品较多，部分产品可能由不同公司负责

SplitItemId.description_en: The split item ID, which is the code corresponding to the specific split granularity of the bill. For example, when OSS is split by bucket, this is the bucket code. It may be empty for records that are not split
SplitItemId.description_zh: 分拆项ID，即账单具体分拆粒度对应的代码，例如 OSS 按 Bucket 拆分时为 Bucket 的代码。未发生分拆的记录可能为空

SplitItemName.description_en: The split item name, which is the name corresponding to the specific split granularity of the bill
SplitItemName.description_zh: 分拆项名称，即账单具体分拆粒度对应的名称

Zone.description_en: The zone. The display name may be returned
Zone.description_zh: 可用区，可能返回展示名称

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page used in this query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页最大记录数
MaxResults.title_en: 单次查询的最大记录数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单次查询的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: The token for querying the next page. If it is not empty, use it as the NextToken for the next request. If it is empty or not returned, the query ends. Even if the number of returned records is less than MaxResults or the current page is empty, you must continue to query as long as the token is not empty
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页查询令牌。非空时原样作为下一次请求的 `NextToken`；为空或未返回时结束。实际返回条数少于 `MaxResults`，甚至当前页为空时，只要令牌非空，仍需继续查询
NextToken.title_en: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
NextToken.title_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位请求
